title: Grisaia: Phantom Trigger the Animation
justification: Checked by episode title against TVDB series 447951. The films are TMDB movies 1437756 (Grisaia: Phantom Trigger the Animation - SORD (2019)), 601980 (Grisaia: Phantom Trigger the Animation - Soul Speed (2019)), 779019 (Grisaia: Phantom Trigger the Animation - Stargazer (2020)). TMDB show 280906 does not carry it, so the node leaves that show. Anime-Lists leaves episodeoffset empty on this season 0 node, which places no regular episode; offset 0 places them. AniDB episode 1-3 ("SORD" to "スターゲイザー" (Stargazer)) are TVDB S0E1 "SORD" to TVDB S0E3 "Stargazer"; AniDB S1-S2 ("90秒で分かるグリザイア: ファントムトリガー" (Grisaia: Phantom Trigger in 90 Seconds) to "特別先行上映会 & トークショウ" (Special Advance Screening and Talk Show)) have no TVDB episode (their defaults are other items). TMDB movies 1437756, 601980 and 779019 are the three films.
